summary.en: WispTerm through Magpie: select models and restore settings on disconnect. Detected by the app's own command or an existing connection; requires a compatible app build.
summary.zh: 通过 Magpie 为 WispTerm 选择模型，断开恢复配置；按应用自身命令或已有接入检测，需要支持 magpie.json 的主程序版本。
